name: BSP_Ai_TargetWeight
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. float __fastcall(ECX = attacker, EDX = attacker vehicle class)(void* target, int target_is_neutral), RET 8 at 00A0980C, weight in ST0. EDI takes the first stack argument at 00A08486 and EBX the second at 00A0847C. The four values form a 16-byte key (00A084A3-00A084BC) into the memo map at 00F8A734 with end sentinel 00F8A738, value at node+1Ch. Order: memo hit (00A0851A), null attacker or target answers 0 (00A08522/00A0852A), forced-rule override through 00A31DB0 (00A08540), otherwise the model. The result is a ratio, total damage over the target's hit points at target+48h, clamped into [0, MaxTargetKillRatio] at 00A09783-00A097B9. Coverage partial: the attacker-is-type-0Fh branch 00A0861F-00A09222 was not transcribed; the barrel model 00A09228-00A09733 was. docs/AI_GLOBALS_AND_TARGET_WEIGHTS.md.

name: BSP_AiCommand_NotifyEntityCommand_NoOp
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ai_group_think, read-only analysis. No Ghidra function; one byte pair at 00A0FC90 on disk, RET 8. The AI command base class's vtable slot +24h, which BSP_AiGroup_ForwardCommand (00A2BD90) tail-jumps to with (command, SceneCommandTarget*). It discards both arguments, so the group's entity-command notification does nothing in every class 00A2DFA0 installs (00D22990 at 00A2E11C/00A2E152 and 00D229E0 at 00A2E13B). 00A0FC90 occurs sixteen times in .rdata, all inside the AI-command vtable block 00D2298C-00D22C68.
